en: The Triplet of the Wholesome (Kusalattika) and the Triplet of the Past (Atītattika)
A wholesome past state is related to a not-wholesome past state by way of object-condition. (Abbreviated. There are eighteen [conditions] in the case of the object;

eleven in the case of predominance; sixteen in the cases of proximity and contiguity; eighteen in the case of decisive support; and sixteen in the cases of absence and disappearance. (The future is similar to the past.)
